parts.name: Scooter Phone Mount (cast silicone)
parts.summary: Silicone phone mount for an Unagi electric scooter, designed in SolidWorks and cast from a 3D-printed mold.
parts.description: Designed for the silicone casting and mold design class. The page will cover the part model, the mold design (cavity, parting line, pour and vent), and the cast result.

parts.summary: A purely mechanical, hand-cranked multi-part mechanism, modeled as a CAD assembly.
parts.description: Personal project. The page will show the assembly, each part with its drawing, and a motion study.
